r04.
Neither NATS nor RabbitMQ. Webhook workers consume from an in-process buffered Go channel, `asyncPostQueue`, declared with capacity 128 in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`; four goroutines consume it in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-54`, and `PostAsync` enqueues deliveries at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:182-190`.
